claimText:
Fix sidecar learning extraction from attached repos.

Goal:
Make `stax:harvest` robust enough to extract useful lessons from a sidecar
without crashing on mixed event schemas or relying on another agent's manual
summary.

Acceptance boundary:
- Do not auto-promote learning candidates.
- Do not weaken proof gates to make Canvas Helper pass.
- Preserve trace-only command evidence as trace, not durable learning.
- Extract reusable sidecar-status lessons into pending review candidates.
- Add regression coverage so this failure does not recur.

STAX acknowledgement: STAX_ACK turn_2026-05-14T19-53-14-613Z_7aa2 5dd54c5e 8e270746

Objective:
Fix STAX sidecar learning extraction so attached repos can produce reviewable
learning candidates without manual summary work from the attached repo agent.

Tests added:
- Mixed sidecar harvest skips non-learning event schemas instead of failing.
- Trace-only command evidence events stay trace-only and do not become learning candidates.
- Latest sidecar status can generate a pending regression candidate.
- URL/prose slash phrases are not treated as repo file-path claims.
- Current-turn capture lag is weak when the report contains the current ACK.
- Negative promotion-control wording does not become a memory promotion claim.
- Canvas Google-hosted course deploys map to `course_deploy_ready`.
- Proof strength has a dedicated `course_deploy_ready` contract.

What is verified:
- `stax:harvest` no longer crashes on mixed sidecar event schemas.
- Trace-only sidecar events do not pollute durable learning queues.
- Canvas Helper produced pending review candidates that STAX can inspect locally.
- The current Canvas Helper status generated an archetype regression candidate for course-deploy proof contracts.
- Course deploy proof now has a named proof-strength claim type: `course_deploy_ready`.
- Future Canvas Helper course deploy prompts can require workspace source proof, export regeneration, STAX-collected deploy command evidence, live target verification, rendered visual proof, and rollback/target-safety proof.
- Negative promotion-control language now stays negative instead of triggering a memory-promotion proof claim.

What is weak/provisional:
- Candidates are pending review only; none were promoted.
- The latest Canvas Helper status was generated on another workstation, so its external command evidence is still not locally reverified on this Mac.
- Existing historical Canvas Helper candidates include repo-memory and regression candidates that still need human review before any durable promotion.

What is unverified:
- No Canvas Helper source code was changed in this turn.
- No live deploy, publish, or sync command was run.
- No sidecar learning candidate was promoted.

Risks:
- The import queue is now correctly populated, but it is still a review queue; repo-specific facts must remain local evidence unless explicitly approved.
- Older sidecar statuses may still show `release_ready` until the upgraded sidecar gate is run again and emits `course_deploy_ready`.

One next action:
- Review the new Canvas Helper pending candidates and approve only reusable abstract rules; keep repo-specific trace facts local.
